title: A collection of R functions to organize, clean and visualize data from the popular korfball application TeamTV
text: TagR helps work TeamTV “tagged shots” exports korfball. provides: quick quality checks (missingness patterns) shot location visualizations korfball half-field team descriptives tables + plots coaching dashboards simple per-player analysis plots (binomial trends distance, pressure, shot count) leg preference slider comparing players glance

title: A collection of R functions to organize, clean and visualize data from the popular korfball application TeamTV
text: TagR includes visualisations shot location, filtered various ways.  Like many functions package, plotting functions accept optional player argument (fuzzy match name exact match number).
code: # Example: result-colored plot (GOAL vs MISS)  p <- TagR::tagr_plot_shots_result(TagR::shots) p # Example: plot shots for player number 11 only p <- TagR::tagr_plot_shots_pressure(TagR::shots, player = "11") p

title: A collection of R functions to organize, clean and visualize data from the popular korfball application TeamTV
text: Compute goal percentages key categories (pressure, distance band, shot type, shot count band, leg). Returns plain data.frames easy inspect test. Plot one attribute quick bar chart:   Filter single player (fuzzy match name exact match number):
code: tabs <- tagr_team_overview_tables(shots)  names(tabs) #> [1] "pressure"   "distance"   "type"       "shot_count" "leg" tabs$pressure #> # A tibble: 4 × 4 #>   level    shots goals pct_goal #>   <chr>    <int> <int>    <dbl> #> 1 ONBEKEND   989   148    15.0  #> 2 MEDIUM     156    25    16.0  #> 3 NONE        38     5    13.2  #> 4 HIGH        13     1     7.69 tabs$type #> # A tibble: 5 × 4 #>   level      shots goals pct_goal #>   <chr>      <int> <int>    <dbl> #> 1 LONG         632    56     8.86 #> 2 SHORT        378    59    15.6  #> 3 RUNNING-IN   112    22    19.6  #> 4 FREE-BALL     39    14    35.9  #> 5 PENALTY       35    28    80 tagr_team_overview_plot(shots, attribute = "pressure") tagr_team_overview_plot(shots, attribute = "distance") tagr_team_overview_plot(shots, attribute = "type", player = "11")

title: A collection of R functions to organize, clean and visualize data from the popular korfball application TeamTV
text: TagR provides simple visualizations show scoring probability changes : distance (capped 10 m) pressure (NONE < MEDIUM < HIGH) shot count band (1, 2, 3, 4+) Player plots optionally include team line/points comparison, can restrict LONG/SHORT shots , including shots open play.
code: tagr_plot_prob_by_distance(shots) tagr_plot_prob_by_distance(shots, player = "11", long_short_only = TRUE) tagr_plot_prob_by_pressure(shots, player = "Joost Dek") tagr_plot_prob_by_shot_count(shots, player = "11")

title: A collection of R functions to organize, clean and visualize data from the popular korfball application TeamTV
text: compact visualization places players left--right “leg preference” slider. uses SHORT, LONG, FREE-BALL shots combines volume success per leg. y-axis shows number shots, dot labeled player name/number.

what: Plot scoring probability vs distance (binomial model) — tagr_plot_prob_by_distance
